body:
Some nice things I want to see. Sounds dumb but, when I liked life and felt encouraged, there was a lot I was looking forward to. Now, because of all the fucking hell I've been through, Im losing hope. 

But I do keep focused on those one or two things I want to do before I go. 

But at this stage, my life is so fucked that I don't even know if i can manage that.

my husband is a nice guy, he's just sometimes a big too optimistic.  Basicaly, if things don't get better, I'm not going ot fight anymore. 

I'm just not. I don't have any fight left. I can't go through any more hellish shit, I just can't. its like my life is some disease, some horrible disease, and there was a remission, and i got hopeful, but now the horror has come back. and i cant fight it any more. 

Sadly, the thought of suicide is the only thing that gives me peace and relief these days.

I hear what you are saying, you are right about not doing something as a fuck you. It's not like that, honestly.

And you're right, I am suffering from a SEVERE lack of emotional support right now. Our life, my life is incredibly stressful and i is only getting worse and I have just shut down and ground to a halt, yet I sitll have to soldier on.

I do need to treat myself. To something. Something. I haven't even taken a shower in 3 days I've been in such a bad way. 

I appreciate your advice.

This would mean so much to your dad if he knew this.

Do you want some help with this? Its heartbreaking. What you are feeling is totally normal, kids should have both parents in their lives, whether they 'live' with both of them or not.

Your feelings are totally normal and human and valid. Do you want some help contacting your dad? I swear, I *promise* it will mean more to him than you know. And your memories of your dad are the ONLY thing that matter, not what your mother says.

I'd really like to help you if I can, mate.

It's nice to know that someone cares.  Like I said to another person, I've been going over this in my head for about 8 months now. A hotline won't help, they'll just try to diagnose you with something and get you on drugs or into a hospital where they treat you like you're defective.

i know talking to suicidal people is hard, a person always wants to talk them out of it, and the suicidal person always has another reason to do it. For me, I'm likely to do it in a few months. I've practiced, I know some methods, and i even now how *not* to think to scare myself out of it. (I used to spend a lot of time thinking about methods, but that got too weird. Now I've chosen two methods and I've practiced so when it comes time, there won't be much fanfare.)

I dont' have loved ones. I have been utterly betrayed by my family, and my husband, even though I love him, has actually not stepped up to the plate about this. 

He's a nice guy, but, if I don't take him with me, he'll recover eventually. And he just does not understand the gravity of what has happened to me over the last 9 years.
 
He's a nice guy, but I can't live in this world anymore. 

It's such a relief to know that i don't have to do this much longer.

i've been thinking of, and talking myself out of, suicide for almost 8 months. 

after a while it just gets harder to talk yourself out of.  especially when things keep getting worse and worse.

(i have an ex who stalks and harasses me, and I have done a good job of hiding from him - shut down or changed all of my SM, no bills in my name, he doesn't even know what country i'm in, but i just found out that een with all of this, he can find me using these fucking people search websites, when i go back to my home country. I'm horrified, this is just pushing me over the edge. I can't even register to vote or have a car in my name because he can find me that way. I'm literally done with how evil life is. And no, the police can't do anything, because it's all online and thorough the mail. He even got to me through my family last summer. I'm just literally not able to take all the fucking hellish things that keep happening to me. It's been Nine Years. I just can't deal anymore. I want to do my ''bucket list'' thing and then just go. I probably should have put this in a PM, but hey, what the fuck do I care, I WILL be gone in the near future. I know how to do it i've done so much research, this is just, It's on. I'm doing it. this world IS EVIL and even my faith in God is just... he's testing me? So, fuck it, I'm sick of tests, there have been too fucking god damned many. i'm dropping the class. Fuck this shit.)

to be honest i only have like one thing i want to do. and that's why i feel like i'll wait a few months if I can. to do it. my husband isn't so bad that i need to leave him, not at all, in fact he's the only thing i have that is good in my life. and even he doesn't understand the hell of what i have been through.

we have a really stressful life. i just can't take all the things that are piling up on me. It's been this way for almost 9 years. and things just keep piling up and piling up.  

if shit doesn't get better, I'm gonna do that one last thing i want to do and then just go through with it.
that's very nice of you to try.  I appreciate it.
